name: PSFCAE: per-sample flooding + adaptive entropy
tagline: Per-sample loss flooding plus a confidence-adaptive entropy bonus that targets only overconfident predictions, with a flood level that ramps over the first 80 epochs.
formula:
$$b(t) = b_{\mathrm{start}} + (b_{\mathrm{end}}-b_{\mathrm{start}})\,\min(t/T_r, 1)$$
$$\mathcal{L} = \frac{1}{B}\sum_i\bigl(|\mathrm{CE}_i - b(t)| + b(t)\bigr) - \lambda_e\,\frac{1}{B}\sum_i w_i H_i,\quad w_i = \mathrm{clip}(1 + 2\,\mathrm{ReLU}(\max p_i - 1/K),\, \le 5)$$
diff_from_baseline: Builds on confidence_penalty (entropy bonus) by making the entropy weight per-sample and tied to overconfidence (max-prob > 1/K), and on RelaxLoss by replacing the alternating CE-target trick with smooth per-sample flooding |CE_i − b(t)| + b(t).

name: ACR: confidence-gated temp + entropy
tagline: Per-sample temperature scaling (rises from 1 to 3 with confidence) plus a sigmoid-gated entropy bonus, both ramped in over the first 50 epochs.
diff_from_baseline: Beyond confidence_penalty (single global entropy weight) and label_smoothing baselines, this temperature-scales the CE per sample by current confidence and gates the entropy bonus through a sharp sigmoid in confidence — both ramped in by training progress.

name: Smooth RelaxLoss (CE/entropy gate)
tagline: Per-sample sigmoid in (target_CE − CE_i) routes between CE descent (hard samples) and entropy maximisation (easy samples).
diff_from_baseline: Reformulates the relaxloss baseline's discrete even/odd epoch alternation as a smooth detached sigmoid gate per sample — same per-class targets but a continuous, gradient-friendly routing of CE descent vs entropy maximisation.

name: CCME: gated entropy + margin compression
tagline: Mild label smoothing plus an entropy bonus and a top-1−top-2 margin penalty, both gated by target confidence and ramped via a logistic schedule.
init_recovers: Label smoothing only at ramp r(t)=0
diff_from_baseline: On top of the label_smoothing/confidence_penalty baselines, restricts both regularisers to high-confidence samples via a detached gate and adds a quadratic margin compression on the top-1 vs top-2 logit gap; class-count normalisation makes terms comparable across CIFAR-10/100/FMNIST.

name: ASER: temp entropy floor + conf ceiling
tagline: After 30-epoch warm-up, uses temperature-3 softmax to enforce a normalised-entropy floor (ramped 0.40→0.75) and a true-class probability ceiling (0.85→0.50).

key_hyperparams.name: warmup_epochs
key_hyperparams.role: pure label-smoothed CE before regularisers fire

diff_from_baseline: Uses temperature-3 softmax (none of the four baselines do) and replaces the global entropy bonus / RelaxLoss alternation with two hinge penalties — one pushing normalised entropy above a floor and one capping the correct-class probability — both with linearly-scheduled targets and weights.
